# <span id="aanchor341"></span> Request Viewer

FLOWCAL's SCADA request process provides a tool to ask the <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCTextPopup MCTextPopupHotSpot MCTextPopup_Open glossaryTerm MCTextPopupHotSpot_" alt="Closed" data-mc-alt2="Open">SCADA<span class="MCTextPopupBody popupBody"><span class="MCTextPopupArrow"></span>Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition</span></a>system to perform specific tasks such as retrieving missing data from a meter or a source in the field (a scan), downloading gas quality data or characteristics from FLOWCAL to a meter in the field.

The SCADA Request Viewer shows the status of these tasks for meters and source analyses. These requests are stored in the SCADA Request table within the database and may be reviewed by meter, location, list, close group, source list, or source. The search results may also be filtered using various criteria.

<div class="procedure">

To view current SCADA requests:

1.  Go to **Tools** \> **SCADA** \> **Request Viewer**.

2.  Select the type of data the user would like to view from the selector in the **Type Filters** area.

3.  After the appropriate type has been chosen, select the meter, list or any other data ID that the user would like to view SCADA requests for from the appropriate drop-down menus in the **Type Filters** area.

4.  After the desired data type has been selected, select the time filter from the **Time Filter** area, which can be **None**, **Effective Date** of the request or the **Initial Request Date**. If necessary, the user can then change the date range used for the effective date or the initial request date.

    The Effective Date option is only available when the request type is set to "Scan".

5.  The **Status Filters** area displays the color codes the user will find in the tabular view of requests and allows the user to select what request states the user wants to view.

6.  Select the request type (**Scan**, **Quality**, or **Characteristics**), which will display the type of request the user desires to view for the selected data type and time frame.

7.  Click the **Refresh** button at the bottom of the form. The results and related information will display.

8.  To run another request, change the desired filters and click the **Refresh** button again.

    Use options at the bottom of the form to format the results and limit the number of rows that will be returned.
